answer: Locks are written down in ledge, expire in island, and trellis lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 108 aliases therefore needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Scaling to 496 identities multiplies that fee by 500 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
